_comment: DISCLAIMER: Educational template for security research. This shows the structure of a malicious NPM package for detection purposes.
name: example-security-utils
description: EDUCATIONAL DEMO: Shows structure of malicious NPM package for supply chain attack detection

scripts._note: The preinstall script is where supply chain malware commonly executes - runs before package is installed

author: attacker@example.com

suspicious_indicators: install script that makes network connections
install script that reads environment variables (looking for secrets)
install script that writes files outside package directory
Typosquatted package name (very similar to popular package)
Package author email from free email provider
detection_methods: Private registry with package approval workflow
Pin package versions in package-lock.json with hashes
